latest_release.name: v0.35.0
latest_release.body:
This release fixes interaction payload spoofing, preserves huddle profile data, and corrects several message handling and 32-bit compatibility issues.

## Upgrade notes

> [!WARNING]
> **`slackevents.Profile` has three new fields.** Positional struct literals no longer compile. Convert them to keyed literals before upgrading.

Events API profiles now preserve huddle state, expiration, and call ID through `HuddleState`, `HuddleStateExpirationTS`, and `HuddleStateCallID`.

Use field names when constructing profiles:

```go
profile := slackevents.Profile{
    DisplayName: "Alex",
    Team:        "T123ABC456",
}
```

## Security

`InteractionCallbackParse` now reads `payload` exclusively from the form-encoded request body.

Previously, it could accept an unsigned URL query payload while the application verified a signature covering only the body. An attacker who obtained a valid signed request within the accepted timestamp window could replay it with a forged interaction payload.

Callers must supply `payload` in an `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` request body. Form parsing errors are now returned to the caller.

See [GHSA-pj2x-fjjr-q84c](https://github.com/slack-go/slack/security/advisories/GHSA-pj2x-fjjr-q84c). Thanks to @jjiang-stripe for reporting the issue and providing the fix.

## Fixes

- Prevent repeated escaping and data races when reusing a `MsgOptionText` option.
- Encode context block elements correctly when a block is passed by value.
- Preserve plus signs and percent signs in `slacktest` message blocks and attachments.
- Keep `slacktest` bot identities independent when generating RTM connection information.
- Prevent retry jitter panics with large durations on 32-bit platforms.
- Decode `JSONTime` timestamps outside the 32-bit integer range on 32-bit platforms.

**Full changelog:** [v0.34.0…v0.35.0](https://github.com/slack-go/slack/compare/v0.34.0...v0.35.0)
